steps.title: Back panel
steps.instruction: Lay the back panel on, smooth side down. Check it is square, then nail it all round.
steps.warning: Measure both diagonals before nailing. If they match, the bookcase is square.
checklist: The back is nailed all round

steps.title: Stand it up
steps.instruction: Get a second person to help. Tip the BILLY bookcase 80×106 up onto its bottom edge, as the animation shows.
steps.warning: Fix it to the wall with the wall fitting before you use it. Furniture that tips over can injure people.
checklist: It stands level on all corners
It is fixed to the wall

faq.answer: The wall fitting is included, but the wall plugs and screws depend on your wall. Ask a hardware shop which ones suit it.

steps.title: Adjustable shelves
steps.instruction: Push 4 shelf pins into the holes at the height you want, then lay each of the 2 shelves on them.
steps.warning: Shelf pins aren’t shown. Put all 4 pins at the same height, or the shelf will rock.
checklist: Every shelf sits flat on 4 pins
